risk_note: RV2 (union/**). Union account and promotion-position (pid) service: every write behind the injected super-admin TOTP check, one transaction per command with its audit row; pid / site_id with whitespace rejected, taobao pid form and site_id checked; registration idempotent when a key is given (the B1-19c CLI always passes one); union_pids.status moves pending -> active -> retired only through the pure transition check canTransitionPid in the union domain layer, applied with a row_version CAS, under the time-limited exception of ops/approvals.yaml id 20 (PR #148, location corrected in #152) until the state machine generator (CT-04) lands. No real union API, no real promotion position. Written by hand.
